layouts.name: Las Vegas GP
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Main named circuit relation follows the Strip, Sands and Harmon course. Alternative relation members and pit lanes are excluded; ordinary-road direction tags do not define race-day direction. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 6210.0 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
